villagepleb_mmo_about: With EpicMMO System: it earns experience as you do, from what it kills, chops, mines, breaks and picks, and its kills count for you too, as a tame's. Its points go where it fights: Strength with weapons or Intellect with staffs (the same points: it uses one at a time), then Body and Vigour. When it falls it loses part of its way to the next level.
